summary: Frontend-only regression RETEST #2 of the Buy Buttons section on /developer-keys?tab=docs (and spot-check on the Keys tab). All critical and secondary acceptance criteria PASS. Section C (Buy Buttons) is correctly mounted on the Docs tab (gated by showDocs — pre-existing routing per iteration_252 agent-note, not a regression). GET /api/buy-buttons?company_id=1 fires exactly once on tab load (no polling loop). The list shows 10 rows for company 1; 1 is ACTIVE (btn_6AyBMuQAiGgwsEQ_sMaWHQ) with bb-archive + enabled bb-edit, 9 are ARCHIVED with opacity 0.75, bb-edit disabled, bb-reactivate present and bb-archive absent. Row chrome (FIXED/CUSTOMER badge, status icon, bb-id-<id>, bb-copy-<id>, meta chips — '35 USD', 'N uses', 'N currencies', 'N metadata', 'All configured', and '10-500 USD (customer chooses)' for CUSTOMER) all render correctly. bb-expand toggles 'Show snippet' <-> 'Hide snippet' and reveals DESCRIPTION / SUCCESS URL / ALLOWED CURRENCIES labels plus a <pre> snippet containing publishable-key="pk_live_wCJi6deu6y-CWIH_q9v0B3RWwQIGL_Al" and button-id="btn_…"; FIXED snippet does NOT contain amount=, CUSTOMER snippet contains amount="50". No 'Create a publishable key first' warning (company 1 has a live pk). bb-copy-<id> fires info toast 'Button ID copied'. bb-reactivate-<id> with PATCH /api/buy-buttons/<id> MOCKED (200) shows success toast 'Buy button reactivated'. Create flow: modal 'Create buy button' (~620px), intro text, all form fields present with correct defaults (label='Pay with crypto', amount='25', hint '≥ 5'), submit disabled empty name/amount<5/invalid-metadata, enabled after valid state; metadata 'not json' shows red hint 'Metadata must be a valid JSON object', valid JSON clears it; currencies chips 'USDT-TRC20'/'USDC-ERC20' DO render live from typed text (visually confirmed in modal screenshot); switching price_type to 'Customer chooses (e.g. donation)' hides bb-form-amount and reveals bb-form-min=10 / bb-form-max=500 with validation (min<5 disabled, max<=min disabled, empty max OK); POST /api/buy-buttons MOCKED 200 closes the modal and shows 'Buy button created' toast with no bb-form-error; POST MOCKED 400 keeps the modal open and bb-form-error renders exactly 'Mock failure'; bb-form-cancel closes the modal without a request. Mobile 390px: buy-buttons-section visible, scrollWidth == clientWidth == 390 (no overflow), bb-create-btn label shortens to 'Create'. Keys-tab regression spot-check: publishable-keys-section renders, pk-revoke-6 opens the shared DeleteModel which now exposes data-testid delete-modal-cancel and delete-modal-confirm. No console errors across both tabs.

issues: Row status text is rendered title-cased ('Active' / 'Archived') while the spec text calls it lowercase 'archived'. Cosmetic only — the ban/circle-check icon, dim opacity, and bb-edit disabled all correctly convey state.

critical_code_review_comments: BuyButtonsSection.tsx is ~631 lines — approaching the 700-line soft cap. The ResourceFormModal/useResourceForm abstraction is good; consider pulling the <pre> snippet renderer (buildSnippet) and the row meta-chip computation into standalone subcomponents to keep this file maintainable.

ResourceFormModal.handleSubmit calls onClose() immediately after submit() resolves — relying on the submit implementation to NOT throw to close the modal. Current implementation is correct, but the contract is implicit. A small JSDoc on useResourceForm's `submit` option documenting 'throw to keep modal open; resolve to close' would help future contributors.
seed_data_creation: None. All POST/PATCH/DELETE to /api/buy-buttons were mocked via page.route; no writes hit the production backend.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The Buy Buttons section lives on the Docs tab (?tab=docs). On the Keys tab (default) only Publishable Keys renders — this is intentional pre-existing routing (ApiKeysPage.tsx: BuyButtonsSection gated by showDocs, PublishableKeysSection gated by showKeys). Iteration_252's 'BuyButtonsSection not mounted' finding was tested against the wrong tab. Chip rendering for bb-form-currencies and pk-form-currencies works correctly — chips render live from the comma-separated input via `upperTokens(form.allowed_currencies_input)`; use a screenshot or query for the chip's .MuiChip-root (not .MuiChip-label alone) via the Dialog's PORTAL root (document.querySelectorAll('.MuiChip-root')) if DOM-asserting. Company 1 currently has 1 ACTIVE buy button (btn_6AyBMuQAiGgwsEQ_sMaWHQ, FIXED, 35 USD) in addition to the 9 archived — the spec said 'all 10 archived' but production data has drifted; any row-count/status re-tests should query live state, not assume all-archived.
rca of the issue: n/a — refactor is a clean pass. No regressions detected on this iteration.
